tasks.contract: TakePrefix(input *[]int, n int) ([]int,bool). input is nonnil. Let old=*input before the call. Valid n means 0<=n<=len(old): return old[:n],true with length n and capacity cap(old), and replace *input by old[n:] with length len(old)-n and capacity cap(old)-n. Both views share original backing storage; do not change its values or other copied headers. Invalid n returns nil,false and preserves caller header and storage. A nil slice accepts n=0 and yields a nil prefix and nil remaining slice. Repeated calls operate on the current header.
tasks.distinct_from: slice-window-001 only returns a view; this API changes one caller-owned header across successive operations while copied headers retain their length/capacity.
tasks.scope: Bounded distinct second encounter; no whole-skill, human-mastery or full-bank claim.

tasks.contract: MoveRange(buf []int,dst,src,n int) bool: validate nonnegative range endpoints without integer overflow; copy exactly n original source values into destination in same storage. Handle both overlap directions and self-copy; preserve all other cells. Invalid ranges return false and change nothing; empty ranges allow endpoints len(buf).

Appends within spare must reuse and update original backing cells; append beyond limit must detach. Preserve input during call; nil/empty valid.

Nil entries are skipped. A false result stops execution, discards its candidate value and preserves prior committed state/count. Do not alter function slice.

Caller aliases observe both changes; repeated calls use current values.
